Name: AbortTransaction
Description: Issues a database ROLLBACK command that undoes all changes performed on the database since the last commit.

Name: Bootstrap
Description: Seeds reference data when missing: client ICNF, project RUBUS, Portuguese 2026 holidays, and SheetUser + RUBUS assignment for the users in Site.SeedTestUsernames. Safe to run more than once. Run by Timer_Bootstrap.

Name: CommitTransaction
Description: Issues a database COMMIT command that makes effective all changes done on the database since the last commit.

Name: FormatMinutes
Description: Formats a number of minutes as hours and minutes, e.g. 2250 -> "37h30" (Separator "h") or "37:30" (Separator ":"). Minutes always have 2 digits.

Name: GetGoogleMapsServerKey
Description: Returns the Google Maps API key setup for this component.

Name: GetMonthCalendar
Description: One CalendarDay per day of the month for the current user, classified (first match wins) as Holiday, DayOff, Confirmed, Weekend, Future (after today, server date) or Pending. IsEditable = weekday that is not a holiday.

Name: GetMonthSummary
Description: Month totals and KPI counts for the current user, derived from GetMonthCalendar. ElapsedDays = Confirmed or Pending days up to today; ExpectedMinutes = ElapsedDays * Site.DailyExpectedMinutes.

Name: GetUserProjects
Description: Active projects (with active client) the current user is assigned to on ForDate, sorted by client and project name.

Name: GetWeekStart
Description: Returns the Monday of the week that contains Date.

Name: Holiday_CreateIfMissing
Description: Creates an active Holiday for HolidayDate unless one already exists for that date (active or not). Used by Bootstrap.

Name: ListAll
Description: Determines if all the elements in the list satisfy the given condition.

Name: ListAny
Description: Determines if any of the elements in the list satisfies the given condition.

Name: ListAppend
Description: Adds an element to the end of a list.

Name: ListAppendAll
Description: Adds the elements of the source list to the end of the destination list.

Name: ListClear
Description: Removes all elements from a list.

Name: ListDuplicate
Description: Duplicates the elements of a list into another list.

Name: ListFilter
Description: Returns a new list with the elements from the List parameter satisfying the given condition.

Name: ListIndexOf
Description: Returns the position of the first element of the List parameter that satisfies the given condition, or -1 if no element satisfying the condition was found.

Name: ListInsert
Description: Inserts an element in a specific position of a list.

Name: ListRemove
Description: Removes an element from a specific position of a list.

Name: ListSort
Description: Sorts the elements of the List parameter by the given criteria.

Name: Login
Description:
Logs a specified user in the application.
In case of success, 'UserId' and 'Username' session variables are filled with the user data.

Name: LogMessage
Description: Registers information that can be presented in Service Center in the module general log.

Name: Logout
Description:
Logs out a specific user from the application.
The 'UserId' and 'Username' session variables are cleared.

Name: SetCurrentLocale
Description: Sets the language locale of the user session to change the application presentation language.

Name: User_GetName
Description: Returns the name of the logged user.

Name: User_GetUnifiedLoginUrl
Description: Returns the Url used for custom unified login patterns. Includes Windows Integrated Authentication pattern.

Name: User_GetUnifiedLogoutUrl
Description: Returns the Url used for custom unified logout patterns.

Name: User_Login
Description: Action to login using username and password as credentials.

Name: User_Logout
Description: Logs out the current user. Session variables are cleared during the logout process.
